title: Red Outdoor Coleus - 2x Plug Plants - Hardy
description: The Red Outdoor Coleus plug plants are perfect for adding a splash of colour to your garden or patio. These hardy plants thrive in temperate climates and love outdoor environments. With their clumping growth habit, these plants are easy to care for and ideal for those who prefer a more low-maintenance approach to gardening. The set includes two red-coloured plants in a soil plug, ready to be planted in a sunny spot. Coleus plants are known for their vibrant foliage, making them a popular choice for gardeners looking to add a touch of brightness to their outdoor space.
